description:
Search current real-estate listings in Germany, newest first.

Returns listings with facts, Somantic's valuation (somantic_valuation_eur,
price_vs_valuation_pct: negative means priced below it) and source_url, the
original listing on the portal that carries the offer.

`last_seen` is when Somantic last confirmed the offer as online. Listings
no longer confirmed are usually removed from results after 3 days.

One offer is often advertised on several portals at once. Those copies are
collapsed to the newest, so a page can hold fewer than `per_page` listings
and `total` counts the copies rather than the offers.

features.description:
Required amenities. "new_building" keeps only new builds
(Neubau, Erstbezug, or built within the last 3 years).

price_below_market.description: Only listings priced below Somantic's valuation.

price_change.description:
Only listings whose price changed while listed: "reduced",
"increased" or "any".

price_max.description: Maximum price in EUR; monthly cold rent when transaction is "mieten".

price_min.description: Minimum price in EUR; monthly cold rent when transaction is "mieten".

price_per_sqm_max.description:
Maximum price per m² in EUR; cold rent per m² when
transaction is "mieten".

price_per_sqm_min.description:
Minimum price per m² in EUR; cold rent per m² when
transaction is "mieten".

q.description: Where — a city ("München", "Frankfurt am Main") or a postcode ("80331").

roi_min.description: Minimum gross rental yield in percent, e.g. 5 for 5 %. Purchases only.

rooms_min.description: Minimum number of rooms (German count, e.g. 2.5).

year_min.description: Built in or after this year.

name: search_listings
title: Search listings
